schema.text: Which travel mode do you most often use for your trips?

options.text: On foot or in a wheelchair (as the main mode of the trip, not just short walks to reach a stop or to change)
Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bolt)

en.#Which travel mode do you most often use: Which travel mode do you most often use for your trips?
en.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bolt)
en.#On foot or in a wheelchair (as the main: On foot or in a wheelchair (as the main mode of the trip, not just short walks to reach a stop or to change)

it.#Which travel mode do you most often use: Quale mezzo di trasporto utilizzi più frequentemente per i tuoi spostamenti?
it.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi o servizio simile (ad es. Uber, Bolt)
it.#On foot or in a wheelchair (as the main: A piedi o in carrozzina (come modalità principale dello spostamento, non solo brevi tratti per raggiungere una fermata o per cambiare mezzo)

fr.#Which travel mode do you most often use: Quel mode de transport utilisez-vous le plus souvent pour vos déplacements ?
fr.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi ou service similaire (par ex. Uber, Bolt)
fr.#On foot or in a wheelchair (as the main: À pied ou en fauteuil roulant (comme mode principal du trajet, pas seulement de courts trajets pour rejoindre un arrêt ou changer de moyen de transport)

de.#Which travel mode do you most often use: Welches Verkehrsmittel nutzen Sie für Ihre Wege am häufigsten?
de.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi oder ähnlicher Fahrdienst (z. B. Uber, Bolt)
de.#On foot or in a wheelchair (as the main: Zu Fuß oder im Rollstuhl (als Hauptverkehrsmittel des Weges, nicht nur kurze Strecken zur Haltestelle oder zum Umsteigen)

tr.#Which travel mode do you most often use: Yolculuklarınızda en sık hangi ulaşım seçeneğini kullanıyorsunuz?
tr.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taksi veya benzeri hizmet (ör. Uber, Bolt)
tr.#On foot or in a wheelchair (as the main: Yürüyerek veya tekerlekli sandalyeyle (yalnızca durağa ulaşmak ya da aktarma yapmak için kısa yürüyüşler değil, yolculuğun ana biçimi olarak)

fa.#Which travel mode do you most often use: برای سفرهای خود بیشتر از کدام روش رفت‌وآمد استفاده می‌کنید؟
fa.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: تاکسی یا خدمات مشابه (مثلاً Uber، Bolt)
fa.#On foot or in a wheelchair (as the main: پیاده یا با ویلچر (به‌عنوان شیوه اصلی سفر، نه فقط مسیرهای کوتاه برای رسیدن به ایستگاه یا تعویض وسیله)

hu.#Which travel mode do you most often use: Melyik közlekedési módot használja a leggyakrabban?
hu.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: Taxi vagy hasonló szolgáltatás (pl. Uber, Bolt)
hu.#On foot or in a wheelchair (as the main: Gyalog vagy kerekesszékkel (az út fő módjaként, nem csak rövid szakaszokon a megállóig vagy átszálláskor)

ar.#Which travel mode do you most often use: ما وسيلة التنقل التي تستخدمها غالبًا في رحلاتك؟
ar.#Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bol: سيارة أجرة أو خدمة مشابهة (مثل Uber وBolt)
ar.#On foot or in a wheelchair (as the main: سيرًا على الأقدام أو بالكرسي المتحرك (كوسيلة رئيسية للتنقل، وليس فقط مسافات قصيرة للوصول إلى محطة أو لتغيير وسيلة النقل)
ar.#Motorcycle, scooter or moped: دراجة نارية أو سكوتر أو دراجة بمحرك صغير
ar.#School bus or shuttle service: حافلة مدرسية أو خدمة نقل مكوكية
